other.penalty:
Summary: a fine.
Indictable: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note
A court before which a care provider is convicted of an offence under section 92 may (whether instead of or as well as imposing a fine) make a remedial order and / or a publicity order

Time Limit For Prosecutions:
None
